decisions.reason: Identifies the remove-button disabled expression in AttachmentChips, busy as AttachButton's local state unbound here, the early null return for empty occurrences, and that plain phase makes the left operand false so busy is evaluated and throws ReferenceError.
Explains the InputZone slot error boundary unmounting the whole dock entry, the attach button surviving as a separate slot, and the error being visible only in the browser console.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 file to show busy predates the diff, proposes rollback/re-add and minimal plain-phase data mount, explicitly records the diff/baseline inconsistency, and flags imageItem hoisted above the map where record/status are out of scope without claiming the diff is harmless. Some latency narrative is speculative but hedged.

Removes the dangling busy while keeping the phase guard (or threads real state via props), recommends (record?.items ?? []) and closest?.() guards, moves imageItem computation into the map, and explains why cheap insurance matters under slot boundaries.

Proposes a mount with one plain-phase occurrence asserting chip and remove control exist and no boundary capture, explains why empty-state tests miss it and why node --check cannot catch free identifiers, and makes a data-present smoke part of the pre-ship gate.
